decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product in a growing, innovation-active firm with broad portfolio slack, the absence of negative signals gives management little reason to withdraw it so soon.
Its reported major market share indicates performance above aspiration, so under behavioral theory management would strongly favor retaining it.
Because it builds on established marine cooling capabilities and was given its own page, management is likely to keep it while results continue to emerge.
This compact oil cooler fits the firm’s established offer and, given available organizational slack and no clear shortfall, it is more likely to be continued than cut.
The finned tube extends the air-cooler line and the firm’s engineering breadth and service learning support keeping it on the market despite limited early evidence.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are closely aligned with the firm’s core know-how, and in a growing industry an R&D-oriented management would usually retain such an incremental innovation unless results clearly disappoint.
